notes: Staying signed in is smoother: the login screen no longer flashes before your pets when the app opens. Password-reset links open the new-password screen reliably, and deleting an account now needs a fresh sign-in for safety.

history.notes: Adding a pet is easier: pick a Shiba Inu or Husky and its colour by swiping, and adoption is now its own step. Your pet faces you instead of looking away, and pet names no longer say 3D.

Set a goal that means something to you: quit completely or cut down, and who you want to be. Insights now shows how close you are, and what helps when an urge hits. Dark mode is darker, and the folded pet page has a softer edge.
The update pop-up now keeps one fixed size and spacing, and the greeting and day line on the pet page fade in place as you scroll.
Your pet is a little bigger when the page folds, and there is less empty space at the bottom.
Notifications now show the Pawse paw and speak to you by name with a little emoji. The health bar lines up neatly with the check-in card.
The pet page is less crowded when it folds: the labels under the icons and the health score row tuck away, leaving more room around your pet.
The pet page now folds smoothly as you scroll and keeps your pet's speech bubble in view, with your pet and today's check-in on one screen.
The pet page now stops scrolling once it has folded, with your pet and today's check-in on one screen. The update popup has a little less space under its title.
The pet page folds as you scroll: the greeting, streak line and speech bubble tuck away and the pet shrinks, so your pet and today's check-in fit on one screen.
Dog reacts to your check-ins: a happy hop when a goal is met, and a sad look for a few seconds after a slip. The greeting is shorter, and Sign out is now at the bottom of Me.
